subject: Mythology
title: The Hydra of Lerna
description: Learn The Hydra of Lerna in one minute.

hook.text: The Hydra was a serpent with nine heads. Every time you cut one off, two more grew in its place.

buildup.text: It lived in the swamps of Lerna, and its breath was so toxic that even its tracks were poisonous.

discovery.text: Heracles realized that cutting heads alone was useless. He needed a completely different strategy.

twist.text: His nephew Iolaus cauterized each neck stump with fire, preventing new heads from regrowing.

climax.text: The last head was immortal, so Heracles buried it under a boulder where it remains forever.

punchline.text: Some problems cannot be cut away. They must be burned.

quiz.question: How did Heracles stop the Hydra's heads from regrowing?
options: He used Medusa's head to turn the stumps to stone
His nephew cauterized each neck stump with fire
He poisoned the Hydra with its own venom
